verdict.rationale: The ClickHouse engine itself is its own dialect: a hands-on user reports "not-quite-standard SQL syntax" along with limited JOIN and DELETE support, so it is not a drop-in for Postgres or MySQL code. The only sign of real-engine compatibility is a brief CLI-doc mention that clickhousectl can create ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services and run local Postgres instances. That suggests actual Postgres is available, but it is documented only in passing. Missing for 10: any documentation of Postgres dialect or extension support in those services, any MySQL or SQLite engine compatibility, and independent confirmation that existing Postgres code runs unchanged.
